__type.name: Checkpoint
__type.description: Checkpoints contain finalized transactions and are used for node synchronization and global transaction ordering.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The checkpoint's globally unique identifier, which can be passed to `Query.node` to refetch it.

fields.name: sequenceNumber
fields.description: The checkpoint's position in the total order of finalized checkpoints, agreed upon by consensus.

fields.name: query
fields.description: Query the RPC as if this checkpoint were the latest checkpoint.

fields.name: artifactsDigest
fields.description:
A commitment by the committee at each checkpoint on the artifacts of the checkpoint.
e.g., object checkpoint states

fields.name: digest
fields.description: A 32-byte hash that uniquely identifies the checkpoint, encoded in Base58. This is a hash of the checkpoint's summary.

fields.name: contentDigest
fields.description: A 32-byte hash that uniquely identifies the checkpoint's content, encoded in Base58.

fields.name: epoch
fields.description: The epoch that this checkpoint is part of.

fields.name: networkTotalTransactions
fields.description: The total number of transactions in the network by the end of this checkpoint.

fields.name: previousCheckpointDigest
fields.description: The digest of the previous checkpoint's summary.

fields.name: rollingGasSummary
fields.description: The computation cost, storage cost, storage rebate, and non-refundable storage fee accumulated during this epoch, up to and including this checkpoint. These values increase monotonically across checkpoints in the same epoch, and reset on epoch boundaries.

fields.name: summaryBcs
fields.description: The Base64 serialized BCS bytes of this checkpoint's summary.

fields.name: contentBcs
fields.description: The Base64 serialized BCS bytes of this checkpoint's contents.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: The timestamp at which the checkpoint is agreed to have happened according to consensus. Transactions that access time in this checkpoint will observe this timestamp.

fields.name: validatorSignatures
fields.description: The aggregation of signatures from a quorum of validators for the checkpoint proposal.
